tagline: FED取景器相机，1959 年发布
description: FED于1959年推出的取景器相机。配备Industar-26m 50mm f/2.8, (ИНДУСТАР-26m), red engraving "П" means coated,。快门速度horizontal-running, focal plane with cloth curtains, speeds: 1/30 - 1/500 +B。使用special take-up spool, removable。Manual focusing, guess the distance。

specs.镜头: Industar-26m 50mm f/2.8, (ИНДУСТАР-26m), red engraving "П" means coated,
specs.快门: horizontal-running, focal plane with cloth curtains, speeds: 1/30 - 1/500 +B
specs.取景器: Reverse Galilean type unusual big viewfinder, 15x11mm, later Zaryas have 15x9mm
specs.闪光灯: on front of the top plate, X sync. 1/30
specs.英文简介: The Zarya is a 35mm film Viewfinder camera, manufactured by F.E.
